entities.summary: Elmer H. Behnke was an American basketball player. Born in Rockford, Illinois, he played collegiately for Bradley University. He was selected by the Rochester Royals in the 4th round of the 1951 NBA draft. He played for the Milwaukee Hawks (1951–52) in the NBA for four games.
